title: His schedule at the Concord
summary: He describes sets and convention seasons at the hotel.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What about your working schedule now? I mean, how's that?

My schedule, it's different. In other words, I'm going to work tonight at 7:30. Now, sometimes, it starts at 5:00 and I play one hour. And then, I won't play no more until 9:15, after dinner and then the show will go on. Then, I'll come back and play at midnight and alternate with the other band until closing, which is 3:00 in the morning. Well, if like they have different conventions up here at times. I have to play at cocktail parties some evenings at 6:30. You know, that's different in hotels and maybe a club where you play 4 or 5 hours straight. But, in the hotel business, you have to go along with the hotel. But, they'd most likely give me a couple of days off if I have to do a certain amount this day, or either be the boss, actually.
It's called hide and run. But, we get a lot of that.

Now, like during this time of year, since the 2nd week of January, it's been a little slow. There's nothing special. I've just come back on the weekend cause I've been working year round which is been, I look forward to that so I can really have 2 or 3 days off, you know. Cause, there's not too many people, like 400 or 500 people, sometimes. And then, other times, we can't, you'd have better than 2,000.
Now, that only happened, this next weekend will be the start of the, there have been about 5 weeks that way all together. And, other times, it's for going, summer, it's very, very crowded.

I guess, they've been staying pretty busy the last few years. So, they have some of the biggest conventions that you'd have that come here. So, the conventions are something like a lifesaver to hotels during the off-season.
